title: Youki ni Naritai Shigure-san
titleNative: 陽キになりたい時雨さん
synopsis: In modern times, it seems like the world only has need for extroverts. They're fun, sociable, thoughtful, and basically top-tier humans. But Yoshida isn't like that... So what if he's a hopeless introvert? So what if he always sits alone in the corner of the classroom? Enter Shigure, a classmate who is in the same boat. She boldly declares she's going to become an extrovert, and she challenges Yoshida to do the same...!? Watch as these two high school students try to make the most of their youth, while they still can!

synopsis: There's always just one surefire way to win in a romantic comedy—simply saying "I like you!" The girls who have feelings for high school boy Izumi spent their days unable to take that first step forward. [The School Idol Who Only Wants to Be Pampered When It's Just the Two of Them] Amane Amasaki. [Even Though I Was Disowned, My Former Fiancé Just Won't Leave Me Alone!] Hakua Shiragiku. [The Angel of the Academy... But the Devil Next to Her Is Surprisingly Easy] Haru Kasuga. However, transferring into their class is Nanao Nanase, a seemingly ordinary girl who is actually a natural-born main heroine! Nano starts her fierce assault on Izumi with her shameless and straightforward approach. "Izumi-kun, I like you. Please go out with me." "Here, say 'ahh'~♪" "Izumi-kun, you're the one who made me into this kind of girl, you know?" In a panic, Amane and the others can't help but spring into action—"This girl... She actually did it!?" Feeling great despair at having lost his rank that he had bet everything to achieve in a world that controlled his life, the protagonist attempts suicide. title: JM
titleNative: J⇔M ジェイエム
synopsis: J is a professional hitman... he was orphaned and raised by the yakuza as an assassin. He was too good, killed too many people, and knew too much about their organization. When the syndicate tried to erase him, their plan backfired...when three syndicates were wiped out completely, J became "untouchable." Megumi, a girl in third grade, was bullied by her classmates because she is half-Japanese, half-American, and gets good grades. One day, when they bumped their heads... they switched bodies. Now J is inside a cute girl's body...and Megumi is inside the tough guy's body. Now they must hide that they are not who they were and keep their everyday lives the same as before. J never knew how hard a girl's life is, and Megumi enjoys her new life?! (Source: BookWalker, edited)
